from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Party(BaseModel):
    """A person or organization involved in the case."""
    name: str = Field(description="Full name of the person or organization")
    role: str = Field(description="Legal role in the case, e.g., 上诉人，被执行人")

class MoneyOrder(BaseModel):
    """A specific monetary ruling or fee order."""
    description: str = Field(description="What the money is for, e.g., 受理费，房屋租金")
    amount: str = Field(description="The monetary amount or calculation description")
    direction: str = Field(description="Flow of money, e.g., 支付，负担")
    payer: str = Field(description="Who pays", default=None)
    payee: str = Field(description="Who receives", default=None)

class LegalDocument(BaseModel):
    """Extracted content from a single legal document."""
    case_type: str = Field(description="Nature of the dispute, e.g., 离婚财产纠纷，专利权")
    doc_type: str = Field(description="Type of legal document, e.g., 民事判决书，执行裁定书")
    court_info: str = Field(description="Court name if identifiable")
    parties: list[Party] = Field(description="All parties and their roles involved in this case")
    case_numbers: list[str] = Field(description="Case numbers cited or assigned in the document")
    verdict: str = Field(description="Core decision outcome, e.g., 驳回上诉，维持原判")
    legal_basis: list[str] = Field(description="Specific laws or articles cited, e.g., 刑事诉讼法第二百五十三条")
    financial_details: list[MoneyOrder] = Field(description="Specific amounts ordered, e.g., rent 15600, fees")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[LegalDocument]
